video.description:
Learn to explain how to talk about timing a task, points in time and a clock that pauses with the device: measure, Instant & SuspendingClock, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
measure - A clock method that runs a closure and returns how long it took as a Duration.
Instant - A single point in time on a clock, which you can compare or move by a Duration.
SuspendingClock - A clock that stops counting while the device sleeps, so it shows time spent awake.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain measure, Instant & SuspendingClock in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
measure, Instant, SuspendingClock 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

measure - A clock method that runs a closure and returns how long it took as a Duration.
한국어: measure: 클로저를 실행하고 걸린 시간을 Duration으로 돌려주는 시계의 메서드

Instant - A single point in time on a clock, which you can compare or move by a Duration.
한국어: Instant: 시계 위의 한 시점으로, 비교하거나 Duration만큼 옮길 수 있음

SuspendingClock - A clock that stops counting while the device sleeps, so it shows time spent awake.
한국어: SuspendingClock: 기기가 잠자는 동안 멈추는 시계로, 깨어 있던 시간만 보여 줌

landscape.hook: Can you explain measure, Instant and SuspendingClock in English?

dialogue.title: How long did the screen take?
dialogue.setting: Adding timing logs to a slow screen

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I need to log how long the screen takes to load.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wrap the loading code in measure. It runs the closure and returns a Duration.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can also save the start time and subtract later, right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Save the start Instant, then call `duration(to:)` on it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A single point in time on a clock. You can compare it or move it by a Duration.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Which clock should I use for the log?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I like SuspendingClock here. It stops while the device sleeps.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So if the phone sleeps for an hour, the log stays short?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. SuspendingClock shows awake time only, so it matches the real work.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. Measure for quick checks, an Instant for long flows.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And SuspendingClock when sleep should not count.
Wrap the slow call in measure.
